title: PhaseLift for Coded Diffraction Patterns: Optimal Sampling Rate
summary: Recovering a complex-valued signal from coded diffraction patterns, namely the Fourier intensities obtained after modulating the signal with a collection of masks, is a fundamental structured phase retrieval problem arising in diffraction imaging and related applications. Despite its practical importance, the theoretical analysis of this structured framework remains scarce. In the standard random mask model, the optimal sampling rate achievable by computationally tractable recovery methods has remained open.
